title: Scramjet Transform Hub startup-config
description: Host startup-config file consumed by Scramjet Transform Hub through --startup-config. The file contains Transform Sequences that should be started with the Hub.

sequences.description: Transform Sequences to resolve and start when the Hub starts.

startSequence.description: Startup entry matching the current StartSequenceDTO contract.

id.description: Stored Sequence identifier to start. For process adapter startup flows, this must resolve from the configured sequencesRoot.

name.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for instanceName. Prefer instanceName for new startup-config files.

sequenceName.description: Optional logical Sequence identifier used for stable agent/operator workflows.

instanceName.description: Optional public Instance label. Use a stable value when an agent must identify the resulting Instance.

required.description: Whether this Sequence is required on the target and should be relaunched according to restart policy.

restartLimit.description: Non-negative restart limit for failed required runs.

appConfig.description: Application configuration passed to the Transform Sequence.

args.description: Arguments passed to the Transform Sequence function.

instanceId.description: Optional explicit Instance identifier. Most users should prefer instanceName for a stable public label.

exposePath.description: Optional path used to expose Instance RPC.

keepAlive.description: Accepted by startup DTO validation. Current host startup does not pass this field into the runner startup payload.
